title: AusTalk: an audio-visual corpus of Australian English
why_promising: Primary Australian English corpus recorded 2011-2016 with 861 adult speakers. Public project documentation states that some data were manually annotated; the annotation case study documents manually created phonemically aligned TextGrids for full scripted word/sentence/read-story tasks for five speakers and manually time-aligned sentence annotations for an additional 35 speakers, with annotation guidelines and later corpus access through Alveo.
open_question: Resolve current file-level access through Alveo/LDaCA and isolate the manually created/corrected TextGrid subset from automatic annotations. Inventory exact speaker/session/task coverage, licenses, and whether downloadable annotation files can be mirrored or only referenced before core admission.
